changes.before: Active as of 2026-09-23; Resolution R-040726b (adopted 2026-04-07) bars data center applications until 2026-10-07. No further extension or adopted data center ordinance was found as of this pass.
changes.after: Extended by Resolution R-100626A: the October 6, 2026 official BOC minutes reproduce the resolution and record adoption 5-0 following a public hearing. Section 2 bars data-center development applications until December 16, 2026; section 4 provides earlier termination upon approval of an additional moratorium after a public hearing or Board action terminating the moratorium; section 5 makes it effective upon a majority vote. Later action has not been comprehensively excluded by this targeted review as of 2026-11-06.
